  ensures result >= 0 and result <= len(xs)
  ensures not (forall x in xs: x <= t) or result == 0

fn is_subseq(a: List[Int], b: List[Int]) -> Bool
  requires len(a) >= 0
  ensures not result or len(a) <= len(b)
  ensures not result or forall x in a: count(a, x) <= count(b, x)
  ensures len(a) != 0 or result
  effects pure
  example is_subseq([], [1]) == true
  example is_subseq([1, 3], [1, 2, 3]) == true
  example is_subseq([3, 1], [1, 2, 3]) == false
  example is_subseq([1], []) == false
{
  match a {
    [] => true
    [x, ..s] => match b {
      [] => false
      [y, ..t] => if x == y then is_subseq(s, t) else is_subseq(a, t)
    }
  }
}

  ensures forall x in result: x % 2 == 0

  example evens([]) == []
  example evens([5, 7]) == []
  example evens([-2, -3, 4, 4]) == [-2, 4, 4]
{
  match xs {
    [] => []
    [h, ..t] => if h % 2 == 0 then [h] ++ evens(t) else evens(t)
  }
}
